introHtml: Blue is a calming and universally loved color, making it a smart choice for baby and toddler promotional items. From soft putty and fidget toys to classic yo-yos and piggy banks, blue adds a soothing touch that appeals to both kids and parents. Perfect for hospital welcome kits, daycare giveaways, or family-friendly events, these items offer high visibility and lasting brand recall. Choose blue to convey trust and serenity while keeping little hands engaged.
